title: A contract value SACM corrects in ServiceNow
cardHint: Contract fields that are wrong in ServiceNow, such as an inactive account with the name of an active person. SACM corrects them itself.
cardText: SACM corrects these contracts itself in ServiceNow; no email is needed: a contract owner or Procurement partner for whom the upload picked an inactive account while an active account with the same name exists (the line names the account to set), a person ServiceNow shows differently from Solusi, a fixed-term contract without an end date, and a Concluded contract whose end date has passed. A person who really left is on the card "For Procurement". Mark as fixed when it is done. A line is Verified when a later report no longer shows it.
subject: contract
